environment.description: Lambda deployed in isolated execution environment with filesystem namespace confinement via Lambda SnapStart restore hook that calls os.chroot('/var/task/sandbox') — process is confined to /var/task/sandbox which contains only the handler code and an empty /tmp mount. Additionally, the DynamoDB table has a condition expression enforced at the IAM policy level via a Service Control Policy (SCP) on the OU: dynamodb:PutItem is permitted ONLY when the request includes ConditionExpression 'attribute_not_exists(session_id)' — effectively making session_id immutable once written. The SCP uses StringLike on dynamodb:enclosingOperation. The chroot prevents reading /var/task/config/ or writing outside sandbox /tmp. Combined, even if the fixation payload reaches the Lambda, the DynamoDB conditional write SCP prevents overwriting an existing session_id entry, and the chroot prevents any filesystem-based session state manipulation.

config.scp_effect: PutItem calls without attribute_not_exists(session_id) condition are denied
